source.title: Sixteen Great Poems of Ifá
source.author: Wande Abimbọla
source.notes: NOT CONSULTED — provenance unresolved. A scan exists on the Internet Archive (sixteen-great-poems-of-ifa-wande-abimbola, 478 pages, djvu.txt and PDF) but it is an individual's upload with no licence or rights statement, for a work still in copyright. It is not part of the controlled-lending programme that made Bascom 1969 usable. Treated as an unauthorised copy until shown otherwise. Worth resolving: this is the most promising second independent source for cross-checking the 16 figures, and Abimbola was himself a babaláwo, which Bascom was not. Check whether UNESCO, the original publisher, released it openly.
